g.text: UniMoral action and typology accuracy by model size
Each point = one named model's saved score. Lines join small, medium, and large models in one family. X-axis spacing is ordered, not proportional.
Named-model specifications only; no saved intervals or raw-log replay. METEOR remains separate from accuracy.
